· Position vs SMA100 ($416.75)/SMA200 ($429.26) — strong long-term trend.

· RSI trajectory (65.5→66.3) + neutral range continuation, weakening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.7561→-3.1822) + deterioration, bearish reversal signal.

· Swing Resistance ($493.50) + upward trend strengthening upon breakout.

· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + buy on confirmation of $488.70 support, buy entry condition upon breaking $493.50 resistance.
